sourceRefs.locator: ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.
pp. 353–355, particularly p. 354. Royal confirmation of Landry’s privilege, sung praise on the model of Agaune, signatories and the king’s parents.
Attestation 1135, place and original wording Clippiaco. The modern identification is Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine; the translation renders the place Clichy. Used for geographical orientation only.

note.de: Der Ausschnitt umfasst das Gebiet bei Clichy und Vieux Saint-Ouen an der Seine. Er lässt die Lage einzelner Räume des frühmittelalterlichen Hofes offen.
note.en: This area covers Clichy and Vieux Saint-Ouen along the Seine. The location of individual buildings of the early medieval court remains open.

note.de: In Clichy stellte Chlodwig II. den erhaltenen Papyrus am 22. Juni 654 aus.
note.en: Clovis II issued the surviving papyrus at Clichy on 22 June 654.
